review_evidence: Source description identifies a graph theory and combinatorics project from the MSRI Lean summer school.
Direct inspection found a substantial directed-graph library with walks, paths, trails, cycles, edge-deletion induction, separators/connectors, and a theorem named Menger.
The nine Lean files contain hundreds of proposition declarations and reusable graph-theory API, so the unit is substantive formalization prior art.
summary: Retain the MSRI graph-theory formalization, including its directed-graph API and Menger theorem development.
